title: Billing and Coding: Cystatin C Measurement

codes.1: Note: Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT codes in their CPT book.

covered.1: It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted. The following ICD-10-CM codes support medical necessity and provide limited coverage for CPT code: 82610

noncovered.1: All those not listed under the “ICD-10 Codes that Support Medical Necessity” section of this LCD.
